items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: And I had a great example of that when one of these dance instructors that we play for said, “You guys need to learn more cha chas like ‘Billy Jean.’” I said, “Michael Jackson’s ‘Billy Jean’?” She said, “yes, a cha cha like that.” So she’s calling that song a cha cha.
Uh huh. I can see why because [scats] you can superimpose the cha cha over it. So I know where he’s coming from.
